name: gemini-cli-bridge
description: Delegate Codex tasks to Gemini CLI for large-context project analysis with strict one-shot model control.

interface.shortDescription: One-shot Gemini consultation for deep project analysis
interface.longDescription: Provides a production-safe workflow to delegate one-shot analysis tasks from Codex to Gemini CLI in headless mode, optimized for large-context reviews by passing all related files directly into Gemini to surface technical flaws, security vulnerabilities, and business-level risks.
defaultPrompt: Review this project with all related files for technical and business risks, then return one actionable report.
Analyze these backend and frontend files together to find vulnerabilities, logic flaws, and regression risks.
Perform a one-shot architecture and delivery-risk audit using the full linked file context.
